_readme: Known convention violations that existed when scripts/check-conventions.mjs was added on 2026-08-04.
This exists so the check can block NEW violations from day one instead of warning forever.
Two kinds of entry live here, and the reason text says which:
'accepted' means the check is wrong about this one and always will be. It stays.
'debt' means the check is right and the fix is scheduled. It leaves when the fix lands.
The file should only ever shrink. A stale entry (one that no longer matches anything) fails
the check too, so a fix cannot land without the entry being removed.
2026-08-04, Brief 37 Part 2: was 20 entries, 5 accepted and 15 debt. All 14 revalidate-schedule
debt entries are gone. Twelve were fixed, one (updatePerson) was deleted as dead code, and one
(deleteContact) turned out to be a false positive and is now accepted, with the reasoning below.
There is no revalidate-schedule debt left in this file, which was the whole measure of that part.

accepted.revalidate-schedule|lib/logistics/plan.t: accepted: writes only the venue hub cache columns on shows (transport_hub_iata, hub_ground_minutes and siblings). None of them render on the schedule.
accepted.revalidate-schedule|lib/logistics/hotels: accepted: same as planTravel, writes the geocode and hub cache on shows only.
accepted.revalidate-schedule|lib/actions/hotels.t: accepted: writes confirmation_number and status, neither of which is in HOTEL_SELECT, so the schedule cannot render them. It revalidates /hotels, which is the surface that does.
accepted.revalidate-schedule|lib/actions/boarding: accepted: writes boarding_pass_document_id on transport_assignments, which the schedule does not render. The uploader tracks its own state.
accepted.revalidate-schedule|lib/actions/contacts: accepted: a newly created contact is not yet on any tour, so nothing on the schedule can be showing it.

accepted: people.contact_id is ON DELETE RESTRICT, so this delete can only succeed for a contact who is on no tour. The day roster reads people joined to contacts, so a contact with no membership row is on no day of any schedule. A contact who is on a tour gets a 23503 and an error message instead, having written nothing. Was listed as debt until 2026-08-04; the constraint is what makes the check wrong about it.
